## HAPI v0.27.2.5

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Hotfix for the fleet version-skew banner: after the v0.27.2.4 rebuild, `MachineCache.getMachines()` lost the `mapLive` live-capability overlay, so the web banner saw every runner as a "legacy runner" (no `runner-self-upgrade` / `cli-artifact-generation` capability) even though all seven machines run the same CLI version. Restores the overlay on machine lists (`getMachines` / `getMachinesByNamespace`) and makes the runner's connect/keepalive identity refresh keep the `asRunner` capability advertisement in stored metadata (previously the socket identity write replaced metadata without capabilities).

No carry/upstream changes; same 33 carried PRs and drop set as v0.27.2.4.

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.2.4` plus the machine-list capability overlay fix.
